Real-rootedness is classified by a quadratic discriminant, the four-positive-root e2 bound <=24, and a strictly positive reciprocal quartic. The standalone exact verifier passed 1809 supplementary checks.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural two-parameter classification for the canonical nonunimodal empty-tetrahedron family: product formation always repairs unimodality, repairs log-concavity only in a sharp finite arithmetic region, and repairs real-rootedness only in the three minimal ordered pairs. The distinctions address the specific product-preservation theme of recent Ehrhart research and provide reusable sharp benchmarks; the finding is not an unmotivated one-off computation.
